'''Verpel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], he attended a ceremony at the [[Imperial Embassy (Etti IV)|Imperial embassy]] on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. There he met [[Elli Stark]], the daughter of [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]], and despite being married, started harassing her. The two were then interrupted by a man named [[Jahan Cross]], an [[Imperial Agent]] who posed as Elli's fiancé, which forced Verpel to leave her alone.<ref name="Agent of the Empire-Iron Eclipse 1" />
